subject.title: fix: drain inbound debounce buffer and followup queues before SIGUSR1 reload

question: Should this PR be allowed to expose a gateway-drain bypass through the public ChannelRunQueue plugin SDK, or must restart-drain work use an internal-only core seam?
rationale: The bypass changes who can enqueue work after gateway draining starts; deciding whether third-party plugins may hold that capability is a security and plugin-contract choice, not a routine code-style repair.

options.title: Keep bypass internal
options.body: Move the restart-drain bypass behind a core-owned internal helper or private implementation type so public plugin SDK consumers only see normal enqueue semantics.

options.title: Accept public SDK bypass
options.body: Document enqueueInternal as a supported plugin capability, add explicit compatibility/security tests, and accept that plugins can intentionally enqueue during gateway drain.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Close or supersede this dirty branch in favor of a narrower restart-drain implementation that does not broaden the public SDK boundary.

recommendation.title: Keep bypass internal
recommendation.body: Move the restart-drain bypass behind a core-owned internal helper or private implementation type so public plugin SDK consumers only see normal enqueue semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person to followup queue, channel run queue, gateway restart, and plugin SDK surfaces touched by the decision.
